name: Gmail
description: List the user's unread Gmail emails (sender, subject, snippet, date) in one call, signed in through their browser.

tools.name: unread_emails
tools.title: Unread emails
tools.description: Lists the latest unread emails in the user's Gmail: sender name and email address, subject, snippet, date and link, plus the total unread count. Shows up to the 20 newest unread messages. Use for 'check my email', 'any new mail', 'unread emails from X', or unread mail in the inbox or a label. Read-only; doesn't mark anything as read.

label.description: Where to look: "^all" for all mail (default), "inbox" for the inbox only, "^iim" for Priority Inbox, or a label name

account.description: Which signed-in Google account, as in mail.google.com/mail/u/<n> (default 0, the first)
